- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the character customization system in The Witcher 3, detailing attributes, skills, mutations, and signs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that Geralt has six attributes: Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, Intelligence, Reflexes, and Endurance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that Geralt has a wide range of skills, including combat skills, sign skills, and alchemy skills.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that there are over 100 mutations in the game, offering a high degree of customization and replayability.
